_comment: Canonical palette. Nothing else in this repo defines a hex value. Python reads it via src/palette.py; the dashboard reads theme/palette.css, which is generated from this file.

ramp._comment: Club gold into black, keyed to content_type and ordered by volume. Six steps is the ceiling - an eight-step version fails the 0.06 minimum lightness gap between adjacent steps, because gold-to-black has only so much range. Key order IS rank order and is frozen on purpose: assigning by name means a data refresh cannot repaint a category. Dark values flip the anchor so visual weight always tracks volume.

residual._comment: Not ranks. Cool greys, deliberately off the warm gold scale so they cannot read as a seventh step. match_preview (79 videos) and full_match (9) live here rather than eating ramp steps - too thin to read a median from, and six steps are better spent on the categories that carry weight. no_playlist is the 815 videos in no playlist at all - distinct from unclassified, which means the playlist is a theme with no single format.

chrome._comment: Club colors for page furniture only - rules, headings, accents. Gold is 2.43:1 on a light surface and must never carry data as a categorical hue.
